text:
anya: Copy review for the API key rotation empty state in Secrets -> Keys. Current headline: "No API keys yet". Feels flat. Proposing: "Create your first API key" with CTA "Generate key". Thoughts?

cole: Prefer benefit-first: "Create an API key to call Redwood" but that's a bit long. CTA "Generate key" is good. Mobile width: 14 chars safe.

faye: A11y note: add helper text under CTA: "Keep this key safe — we won't show it again." and include an aria-live polite region when key is generated. Also add an info tooltip next to headline: "Rotate keys regularly" linking to docs.

marta: Tone nit: "Keep this key safe" reads like a command. Maybe: "You'll only be able to view the key once. Store it securely." Shorter: "You'll see the key once — save it now."

sam: For enterprise we sometimes need more context: mention scopes and expiration. Suggest optional subtext: "Choose scopes and expiration when generating." Keep collapsed by default.

anya: Updated candidate copy:

Headline: "Create your first API key"
Body: "You'll see the key once — save it now."
Primary CTA: "Generate key"
Secondary link: "Key rotation best practices" -> /docs/keys#rotation
Tooltip (short): "Rotate keys regularly and limit scopes."

cole: LGTM. For SRs, add aria-label on CTA: "Generate a new API key" and aria-describedby for the body so SRs read the save warning when focused.

faye: Also ensure tooltip text is concise for screen readers: "Rotate keys and restrict scopes."

marta: I'll update Figma and include copy variants for the hover tooltip and a collapsed "advanced options" with scope/expiry.

design-bot: Copy suggestion recorded  ticket #CI-7391 (assigned to marta).
